credit_metrics.text: EBITDA fell by {{ebitda.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda@FY2024}}, and operating profit declined by {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} to {{operating_profit@FY2024}}.

Total debt was reduced by {{total_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{total_debt@FY2024}} and net debt by {{net_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{net_debt@FY2024}}, yet gross leverage rose by {{gross_leverage.change@FY2024}} to {{gross_leverage@FY2024}} as EBITDA fell.

Interest coverage improved by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}}, while FFO fell by {{ffo.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo@FY2024}} and FFO to debt was broadly unchanged at {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}}.

Free cash flow rose by {{fcf.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf@FY2024}}, lifting FCF to debt by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}}, helped by capex intensity falling by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, and cash liquidity to revenue declined by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.
Total liquidity was {{liquidity@FY2024}}, including {{undrawn_facilities@FY2024}} of undrawn committed facilities, equal to {{liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}} of revenue.

Advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, with contract liabilities up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}}, so a larger share of liquidity is customers' prepayments.
Funding was refinanced during the year: S&P assigned Finnair an issuer credit rating, and a new unsecured senior bond was issued alongside a new secured revolving credit facility.

operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2024}} to {{passengers@FY2024}}, while the fleet was stable at {{fleet@FY2024}} aircraft.
The fuel share of costs fell by {{fuel_share_of_costs.change@FY2024}} to {{fuel_share_of_costs@FY2024}}, above the peer median of {{fuel_share_of_costs.peer_median@2024}}.
A new A350 was delivered during the year and Finnair purchased a leased A350 and a leased A321, all in operative use at the balance sheet date.

peer_positioning.text: Finnair sits in the middle of the network group on EBITDA margin ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@2024}}), at {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}.

Its net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2024}} and gross leverage of {{gross_leverage@FY2024}} are both above the peer medians of {{net_leverage.peer_median@2024}} and {{gross_leverage.peer_median@2024}}, ranking {{net_leverage.peer_rank@2024}} and {{gross_leverage.peer_rank@2024}} respectively.

Interest coverage of {{interest_coverage@FY2024}} and FFO to debt of {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}} are below the peer medians of {{interest_coverage.peer_median@2024}} and {{ffo_to_debt.peer_median@2024}}, both ranking {{interest_coverage.peer_rank@2024}}.

FCF to debt of {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}} places Finnair in the middle of the group ({{fcf_to_debt.peer_rank@2024}}), and capex intensity of {{capex_intensity@FY2024}} is below the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@2024}}.

snapshot.text: Finnair, the Finnish network carrier, ended FY2024 with revenue up {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}} but earnings lower, as industrial action in Finland led to flight cancellations in the early and late parts of the year.
The EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}, and net leverage rose by {{net_leverage.change@FY2024}} to {{net_leverage@FY2024}}.

Leverage is the point to watch: net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2024}} is the weakest of the network peers ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@2024}}), and cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.

watch_items.text: Leverage: net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2024}} is the weakest of the network peers ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@2024}}) and rose by {{net_leverage.change@FY2024}} over the year as EBITDA fell.
Earnings: the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}, leaving less cushion against a fixed cost base.

Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}} sits in the middle of the group ({{advance_ticket_cover.peer_rank@2024}}), so a large part of liquidity is refundable if bookings slow.

Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, in the middle of the group, with {{undrawn_facilities@FY2024}} of committed facilities available.
